resident_flux3_diagnosis.scope: Additional resident-DiT diagnosis, separate from full-pipeline benchmark.
resident_flux3_diagnosis.note: Fully resident BF16 DiT, shared cached BF16 conditioning, no encoder/VAE. Separate from full-pipeline results.

visual_review.result: All nine displayed conditions preserve the red sphere, blue cube and yellow pyramid. Reflections, outlines, colors and fine background seams differ; no blank or structurally broken image observed. This is not a perceptual score.

notes: Comfy Qwen measured runner is archived by its SHA; the later changes only handle scalar and training-only counter validation before Flux inference. Native Comfy inference code was unchanged.
Failed untiled/default VAE attempts are excluded from timings and retained as diagnostic evidence.
